items.b: SOTHEBY'S SELLS HK$267.5M IN HONG KONG AS RUBIES TAKE TOP THREE
items.t: A Mauboussin ruby necklace made HK$16 million against an HK$11 million high estimate. Cartier tutti frutti earrings made 9.3 times their HK$850,000 high estimate.

items.b: SILVER ADDS 4.87% TO $66.835, HIGHEST MARK SINCE 31 AUGUST
items.t: Gold added $65.00 to $4,375.70, platinum $38.00 to $1,807.00 and palladium $35.00 to $1,305.00. LBMA's Thursday fixes sit below all four.

items.b: PATEK PHILIPPE SPLIT-SECONDS CARRIES CHF 4M ESTIMATE AT PHILLIPS
items.t: The 1945 chronograph heads the Geneva Watch Auction XXIV on 7 and 8 November. Four of the five named lots carry an upper estimate only.

items.b: STULLER PUTS JEWELLERY STORES AT 26% OF DOORS, 48% OF DOLLARS
items.t: Harold Dupuy told the AGS Conclave in Orlando that jewellery is taking share from big-box stores. No period or denominator was published.

items.b: GJEPC TAKES 89 INDIAN COMPANIES INTO 1,228 SQ M IN HONG KONG
items.t: The India Pavilion opened at AsiaWorld-Expo on 14 September and the convention centre on 16 September. The fair draws exhibitors from 44 countries.

tape_ts: 18 Sep 2026 - Kitco's bid, re-read by the Editor at 06:03 ET under the One-Price Rule and filed to Carat Capital's dated tape and to latest.json in the same step: gold 4,375.70, silver 66.835, platinum 1,807.00, palladium 1,305.00. All four are higher against the 17 September marks in Carat Capital's own record. LBMA's published 17 September fixes sit below all four, so both pages agree on direction.
